facts.text: Everyone says the water is safe. I'm watching it anyway. Eat quick and keep the kids close to shore.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Brody's words, but he never says it. It is not on the Wikiquote page. His real lines include 'I think we may have another shark problem.'
facts.fix: "I think we may have another shark problem."

fix_note.text: I think we may have another shark problem.

facts.text: Buttermilk soaked calamari in a cornmeal crust, with tartare and lemon.
facts.why: This is the note under 'Amity Island fried clams', but it describes calamari. It was copied from the 1975 menu. The dish is clams.
facts.fix: Buttermilk soaked clams or squid, cornmeal crust, tartare and lemon.
facts.applied_note: The recipe cooks calamari, so the note names both. Kept to the old length so the kiosk still prints its notes.

facts.why: Mayor Vaughn and the developers push summer business, but neither source shows a sign with these words.

facts.text: Ellen's Holiday Inn opening, poured on the lawn.
facts.why: Ellen is at a fundraiser and the town has new development plans, but the sources do not mention a Holiday Inn opening or drinks on a lawn.
facts.fix: Ellen's fundraiser, where Brody turns up late.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the teenagers set sail.
facts.why: Mike, Sean and the other teens go sailing on six boats. Fits.

vibe.verdict: A fun beach kiosk with a clever surf report, but it leans on the first film and misses the sequel's own big moments.
